title: Scheme groupoid restriction saturation and endpoint projections
statement: Let $U,R,B$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $s,t:R\to U$ and $g:B\to U$ be morphisms, and use the chosen fibre products [def-pc-fibre-product]. Put $W=B\times_{g,U,t}R$, with projections $\pi_B:W\to B$ and $\pi_R:W\to R$. Define the saturation map $h:W\to U$ to be $s\circ\pi_R$. Put $R_B=W\times_{h,U,g}B$ with projections $a:R_B\to W$ and $b:R_B\to B$. Define the restricted source $s_B:R_B\to B$ to be $b$ and the restricted target $t_B:R_B\to B$ to be $\pi_B\circ a$. Thus on every test scheme the triples $(u,r,v)$ satisfy $g(u)=t(r)$ and $s(r)=g(v)$, the restricted source is $v$, and the restricted target is $u$. These definitions require no groupoid laws or finiteness hypotheses.
